short: He murdered his co-emperor brother within the palace and ruled alone through military favour and force.
full:
Caracalla was made co-Augustus alongside his father Septimius Severus on 28 January 198 CE and inherited the throne jointly with his younger brother Geta in February 211 CE. The arrangement, which their father had hoped would keep the dynasty stable, broke down within months: Caracalla had Geta murdered in their mother's arms that December and then had the Senate condemn his brother's memory.

Caracalla ruled alone for six years, sustaining the military pay rises his father had begun and extending Roman citizenship to nearly all free inhabitants of the empire, a measure that broadened the tax base as much as it granted status. He was assassinated by one of his own guardsmen on 8 April 217 CE while travelling toward Carrhae on a Parthian campaign, killed on the orders of his own praetorian prefect.
